messages:
kevin: Follow-up from the cache-eviction postmortem. We agreed we need a concise 'fast triage' section in the runbook (5 bullets), exact pasteable commands for oncall, and a short escalation ladder with timeboxes and role owners. Who takes what?

maya: I can assemble the 5-bullet fast-triage. Draft: 1) scope (model vs cluster), 2) snapshot kvcache KPIs, 3) inspect eviction events & reason, 4) apply immediate mitigation (shard tweak / fallback route), 5) tag + notify. Will keep each one one-line and action-oriented.

oliver: I'll prepare the copy/paste commands and examples. Proposed snippets to include verbatim: ```bash
# show recent evictions
redwoodctl telemetry events list --type eviction --since 20m --format short

# kvcache hit-rate (5m)
redwoodctl metrics query "increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])"

# tail runtime logs (last 15m)
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 300

# quick fallback to smaller model
redwoodctl route set --model model-small --traffic 100% --reason "eviction-fallback"
```

rachael: I'll own the escalation ladder. My suggestion: ack by oncall <10m, eng-sre in 20m if unresolved, eng-runtime in 45m, leads + customer-sre at 90m. I'll produce a role-based primary/secondary table and add rotation overlap checks.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1609 attached to this thread. Reminder: runbook edits due in 7 days.

maya: Mitigation cookbook I'll include: if hit-rate drop >30% and evictions > threshold -> increase kvcache shard_limit +15% and restart cache pods one-at-a-time. If eviction reason == "oom" -> reduce batch size or route to model-small. Example command: `redwoodctl config patch kvcache --shard-limit +15% --reason "mitigation"`

oliver: I'll also paste example log lines to match so triage can be faster (eviction_reason=kv_overbudget, OOM stack frames). And a one-line troubleshooting mapping: reason -> immediate next step.

kevin: Let's assign deadlines: maya -> triage doc (2bd), oliver -> commands + examples (3bd), rachael -> escalation table + contacts (4bd). I'll schedule a 25m review 48 hours out.

maya: ACK, starting PR in playbooks/ and will tag @oliver for command review.

oliver: ACK, will validate commands and attach sample outputs.

rachael: ACK, will confirm primary/secondary and rotation overlap.

kevin: Final note: include telemetry markers to watch in the runbook: 95th token latency, kvcache hit-rate, eviction rate. Add a single-sentence rule: if unsure, prefer traffic reduction to the suspect model over mass pod restarts.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: PR ping in 72 hours.
